description: Full text of one or more Articles of an act, with a verifiable EUR-Lex citation URL for each. THE article-level grounding tool: quote GDPR Art. 17, AI Act Art. 6, etc. Accepts a single number ("17"), a comma list ("5,6,17") or a range ("5-9").

article.description: Article selector: "17", "5,6,17", or "5-9". Suffixed numbers like "9a" are supported.

celex.description: CELEX id or a known alias (e.g. "GDPR").
